zh-Hant.title: 1.4.3 有什麼新功能
highlights: 新版本推出時會在 App 內提醒你更新。
升級後首次開啟會顯示這個「新功能」說明。

en.title: What's new in 1.4.3
highlights: The app now reminds you in-app when a new version is available.
After upgrading, this "What's new" summary appears on first launch.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.0 有什麼新功能
highlights: 跨裝置同步：課表、課程顏色與作業狀態可以在你的裝置之間同步，可在「設定」中關閉。
新增了 GPA 即時計算，不需要等待學校系統出來。
修復了許多 bug。
顯示該頁面使用的伺服器以及其狀態。
其他許多大改進與變化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.0
highlights: Cross-device sync: your timetable, course colours and assignment state can follow you between devices. Turn it off in Settings.
Added real-time GPA calculation, no need to wait for the school system.
Many bug fixes.
Shows which server is used for this page and its status.
Many other improvements and changes.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.1 有什麼新功能（沿用 v2.0.0 內容）
highlights: 因為 Play Store 跳過 v2.0.0，故此版本新內容沿用 v2.0.0 內容。
跨裝置同步：課表、課程顏色與作業狀態可以在你的裝置之間同步，可在「設定」中關閉。
新增了 GPA 即時計算，不需要等待學校系統出來。
修復了許多 bug。
顯示該頁面使用的伺服器以及其狀態。
其他許多大改進與變化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.1
highlights: Due to Play Store skipping v2.0.0, the new features in this version are the same as v2.0.0.
Cross-device sync: your timetable, course colours and assignment state can follow you between devices. Turn it off in Settings.
Added real-time GPA calculation, no need to wait for the school system.
Many bug fixes.
Shows which server is used for this page and its status.
Many other improvements and changes.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.2 新功能
highlights: 課表時間修正
修正 TigerSync 相關詞匯
修正 Widget 顯示成其他版面或錯誤畫面的問題
翻譯優化
行事曆顯示優化

en.title: What's new in 2.0.2
highlights: Class table time correction
Fix TigerSync related terms
Fix the problem of Widget displaying other layouts or error screens
Translation optimization
Calendar display optimization

zh-Hant.title: 2.1.0 新功能
highlights: TigerSync 設定頁重新整理
通知設定跨裝置同步
修正 Moodle 登入過期時不會顯示的通知
即時更新提前時間與 iOS 版一致
推播依 App 介面語言顯示

en.title: What's new in 2.1.0
highlights: TigerSync settings page reorganized
Notification settings sync across devices
Fix the notification that never appeared when the Moodle login expired
Live Updates lead time now matches the iOS version
Push notifications follow the app's interface language

zh-Hant.title: 2.2.0 新功能
highlights: 修正三星 NowBar、小米系列超級島以及其他品牌手機的即時更新顯示問題
修正了多部門合開課程無法連接 Moodle 的問題
修正了新增課程不會即時顯示的問題
新增校園信箱功能
設定中可以查看 App 使用的開源授權
設定中的「關於」頁面重新整理，相關連結更好找
課表與課程詳情顯示更多課程資訊
公告頁面的滑動與搜尋操作優化

en.title: What's new in 2.2.0
highlights: Fix Live Updates display on Samsung NowBar, Xiaomi series HyperIsland and other devices
Fix the issue of courses co-taught by multiple departments cannot connect to Moodle
Fix the issue of newly added courses do not display immediately
Added campus email feature
View the open-source licences the app uses in Settings
About page in settings reorganized, making links easier to find
Class table and course details show more course information
Improved scrolling and search on the bulletins page

items.title: 全新的新功能介紹
items.body: 更新後會逐頁介紹新功能，跳過的版本也會一併補上。

items.title: 恢復預設底部功能列
items.body: 自訂過底部功能列的話，可以一鍵回到預設的項目。

items.title: 收件人變成泡泡
items.body: 寫信時輸入的收件人會變成泡泡，收件者與副本各自一行。

items.title: 通知跟著語言走
items.body: 通知類別與即時更新的文字會使用 App 的語言，切換語言後也會跟著改。

items.title: A new What's New
items.body: New features are introduced page by page after an update, including any versions you skipped.

items.title: Reset the bottom bar
items.body: If you've customized your bottom bar, you can go back to the default tabs in one tap.

items.title: Recipients as bubbles
items.body: Recipients you type turn into bubbles, with To and Cc on lines of their own.

items.title: Notifications follow your language
items.body: Notification categories and Live Update text use the app's language, and follow it when you switch.
